svg.title: The site
svg.desc: Path: /app/wizard, What it exercises: Onboarding in three steps with validation: required name, email format, plan, seats from 1 to 500, terms. The last step shows a confirmation number.; Path: /app/feed, What it exercises: Infinite scroll: an IntersectionObserver sentinel loads 20 items at a time, 100 in all. One seeded item past the first 60 is marked ★ featured.; Path: /app/popup, What it exercises: Reports: a target=_blank link to /app/report, whose report number is logged when viewed.; Path: /slow, What it exercises: The forecast appears 1.5 s after load. It is fetched then, so it is not in the HTML.; Path: /heavy, What it exercises: 200 images from /img/<n>.png, 96×96 incompressible PNGs generated in memory (about 4.9 MB), all Cache-Control: no-store.; Path: /captcha, What it exercises: A security check showing digits in an image, meant for a person. Solving it logs captcha_solved. If the page's window gains focus (Umbra's handoff shows it), the page logs captcha_focus.
